name: Construction_Drones_Meketreve
title: Construction Drones - Meketreve flavor
author: meketreve
description:
Adds ground based construction robots. Fork of daz96050's fork of Tubbles' repackage of Klonan's original mod.

The drones take their items out of your inventory, and, once you build a drone garage, out of the chests you wire to it.
